title: Anthropic’s $2T IPO, Elon Predicts Neocloud Death, and China’s Kimi Catches Up | #306
description:
The mates sit down with Emad Mostaque to discuss the latest developments in AI, from Anthropic’s rapidly growing revenue and potential $2 trillion IPO valuation to Elon Musk’s prediction that neocloud providers are headed for extinction. They also explore CoreWeave’s 30% stock decline, the rise of Chinese AI models like Kimi, and whether mounting concerns about valuations and infrastructure spending signal that the AI bubble could be nearing its breaking point.
